About
Version %1$s
Offline. Hardware-backed. Zero tracking.\nYour keys never leave your device.
Veilo Authenticator generates time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords for two-step verification. It works entirely offline — no internet connection, no account, no tracking.
How to use

1. Add an account: tap + and scan a QR code, or enter the secret key manually.

2. View codes: your one-time codes appear on the main screen. Tap to reveal and copy. The code is cleared from the clipboard after 30 seconds.

3. Pin favorites: long-press an account to pin it to the top of the list.

4. Groups: organize accounts into groups (Work, Personal, Finance, etc.) from the edit screen.

5. Backup: use the encrypted backup to save your accounts to a file protected by a passphrase. You can also generate a printable PDF with QR codes.

6. Migrate: import accounts from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis via the transfer menu.

7. New phone: open Menu > Transfer to another phone on both phones. The accounts move directly over encrypted QR codes, without any file or internet connection.

8. Lock: the app locks automatically when you leave it. Unlock with your biometric or device PIN.
Security

• Keys stored in hardware-backed Android Keystore (StrongBox when available)
• Biometric or device credential required to unlock
• Screen capture and app-switcher preview blocked
• Copied codes cleared from clipboard in 30 seconds
• Secret key material zeroed in memory after use
• Root and debugger detection at launch
• No internet permission — fully air-gapped by design
• No analytics, no tracking, no third-party services
• Encrypted backup with passphrase-based key derivation
• ProGuard/R8 code obfuscation in release builds
• Cloud backup and device transfer explicitly disabled
Veilo Ecosystem
Veilo Authenticator is part of the Veilo Technology ecosystem — a suite of self-hosted, zero-trust enterprise security products.

Google Authenticator
In Google Authenticator, tap ⋯ → Transfer accounts → Export accounts. A QR code will appear — scan it here.
Microsoft Authenticator

Aegis Authenticator
In Aegis, tap ⋯ → Export → Choose format: Plain text, then save the JSON file and select it here.
Printable PDF backup
Generates a PDF with one QR code per account. You can print it and store it in a safe place as an offline backup. Each QR code can be scanned by any authenticator app.
